notes.title: Major update coming! Need your opinions please!
notes.content:
Hi there!
So for the past year and a half I've been working on Gnomes vs. Fairies 2: Moons of Ventocia, and I've learned a lot in the process and I'm about to release a major update for Gnomes vs. Fairies that fixes a lot of what I didn't know enough to know sucked about it!
This includes the players acceleration and movement speed, a COMPLETE overhaul of the camera. (Oh how did you people put up with such a terrible camera for so long?) and many more little fixes and changes and improvements.

I will NOT be fixing the speedrunning bugs or exploits that the speedrunning community enjoys so much, but my next game you'll have a harder time, although I'm excited to see what you make of it!

My big question is this:
I'm thinking of sunsetting the online portion of the game.  It's not that there's anything wrong with it, it's just the player base is way too small and I almost never see anyone else online.  I just feel like it's a waste of people's time to go in and never get to see anyone.

Would anyone miss the online play I've added if I took it away?
Thanks for your input!

Also, follow development of my next game, Moons of Ventocia on facebook here: https://www.facebook.com/Moons-of-Ventocia-258731811389300/

and twitter here: https://twitter.com/moonsofventocia

Dano

notes.title: Big 2 player update today, and tall-ball world's physics are fixed!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 
I did a lot of work on 2 player gameplay today.

The girl gnome 2nd player is fixed now, she won't always twist her torso like a weirdo anymore.

Both players now have separate health, and some mobs aggro player 2 now, getting the rest to aggro will take quite a while so that's coming next.

Also, I redid the physics on Tall-Ball world and gave the ball a lot more friction which should make it much easier to control. I hope you try it out and let me know how it feels for you!

Dano

notes.title: Huge update, controls changes, and more!
notes.content:
Well, I've been working hard as usual!

The newest update sees an overhaul of the controls!

Now there are two new buttons for controller and keyboard.

Sprint: Left-Shift or LTrigger on xbox one controller.
AutoAim Toggle: Left Ctrl or RTrigger on xbox one controller.

When you are sprinting and moving, you do a dive attack. When you are sprinting, airborne and still, you do the stomp attack.

Also, door switches are auto-targeted now so you can easily open the doors with berries.



I hope to see you online in about 2 hours!

notes.title: Many fixes from this week's major update.
notes.content:
Fixes:

*Water was invisible (interfered with by new VR camera fader)

*Prismatic Cloak (Invisibility power) works again, enemies can't see you when the cloak is engaged!

*Arrow was invisible, fixed!

*Super Boss Golem of "The Void" now attacks you back and has a more boss like behavior. He wasn't responding and you just could kill him!

        Changes:

*Shortened the draw distance of the camera for faster performance.  I'm going to add a slider for it in the quality settings.

*Reverted to Old Magic Hat. Witch hat design didn't look good.

        Added:

*Mouse got Sound Effects, voice, and better animations, and it's own music.
*Mouse got dynamic tail bones, so the tail wiggles and moves like a real mouse (THIS MADE A HUGE DIFFERENCE!)

*Each town center now has a giant Fairy Statue when you capture all the fairies in that world and a giant Gnome statue when you free all the gnomes in that world.

*With fairy wings equipped, you will now do a dive attack if you are moving forward and the stomp attack when you aren't moving, but it only goes down a little while and won't carry you way way down to the ground (so it won't accidentally kill you!)


The game will update on steam within a few hours, if there are any little bugs or things you want me to fix that I didn't mention, let me know!  Thanks everyone.
Dano

notes.title: Major Optimization update. Frames per Second has DOUBLED!
notes.content:
And there is no visual sacrifice!
I created a system which disables and enables objects based on location.

It's been 2 weeks fixing all the bugs this system caused but the frame rate benefit was absolutely worth it, ESPECIALLY for vr.

On my system with the Oculus Rift DK2, i now get a solid constant 75 fps at all times with no dips.  (The DK2 maxes out at 75 fps, the CV1 caps at 90).


Please report any strange behavior, like monsters not dying, mushrooms not bouncing, moving platforms not moving, etc.

VR users please let me know if the framerate has improved for you!

Thanks for waiting everybody, this update was a BIG one!!!
Also, Gnomes vs. Fairies: Greckel's Quest is going to be at Xpo gaming convention in Tulsa this coming weekend! If you are around come out and see me and try the game in VR.  

Also: I added a bow and arrow weapon!!  Name your character Dano and bounce up the green shroom at the beginning to put the game in developer mode and try the new bow and arrow, it's really awesome!!
-Dano

notes.title: Big update, fixes, changes, gameplay updated
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I'm hoping to round up the last of all the bugs in the game this week so please post in the community if you are having any issues you notice!

So far on the newest release:

Fixed:

*Bugs walking up stairs, getting stuck, etc.
*Fixed possibility of cheating your way up icy patches by using sword combos
*Beginning game loading bar fixed, now reaches %100
*Fixed the cursor unlocking when tabbing out and in to the game
*VR UI is 95 percent complete!

Added:

*Invert Y option for camera
*Controller Support for color boxes and character creation menu
*A little cursor to the menu to help you see what's selected
*Speed blast after running for a little while


Changed:
*Changed the entire feel of the character!!
*Changed the style of double jump to an air double jump.
*Disabled 2player in VR
*Gravity/Fall speed adjusted to fix "floaty" feeling, if you like it, let me know, if it was better before, let me know too!  Jumping should feel faster and hopefully more precise.

notes.title: New Update - Added two player support!
notes.content:
Press "Enter" on the keyboard to spawn a second player! Right now it's really beta so there's probably a lot of bugs with it.  To set up the second player's controls look for 1_Fire, 1_Horizontal, etc.

Eventually there will be 4 players simultaneously if you have enough controllers!

At this point you can test player 2 right away, just hit Enter (return, not keypad enter) on the keyboard, and the controls are I,J,K,L instead of WASD, and the other buttons are [, ', ], and \.




Also, most if not all bugs related to gameplay that have been mentioned are fixed. There are still problems with achievements and I'll be sorting those out soon.

Remember - player 2 is in BETA! That means there might be lots of bugs when you use it.  Have fun and let me know any player 2 bugs you might find!

-Dano


Known Bugs with 2 player active:
Quit button doesn't work, fades to black, have to quit game to fix.
This update broke the girl gnome!
Fixed already, uploading a fix, should be up in the next 2 hours. Sorry!

notes.title: Big update! Bug fixes, new features, mouse riding, and Music Creation Contest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
I'm about to release the newest update that includes all the bugs mentioned so far in the forums, and in addition some new features!

*New Axis buttons in the mapping:
DPadY - for zooming camera in (your D-pad up and down)

*Added cheese to the store in Queens' Garden. Go have fun riding the mice around!

*Camera now supports up down motion as well as side to side, and now you zoom in/out with the Dpad or the mouse scroll wheel like always.

*Some Achievements fixed, FairiesCaptured and MonstersKilled should work now

*Directional Lightmaps and Specular lightmaps added to many levels. This makes the file size bigger but the game looks way better with Baked normal maps (texture shadows)

*Fairies Captured are now unique and tracked and saved. So when you catch a fairy once, it stays caught forever and never comes back.  Please report any issues with this system to me!

*Finished all gnome dialog for all gnomes!

*Stores no longer auto sell you the first item on the list!

*Fixed the bats stupid hitbox and how annoying they are. Better now!

Also, I'm having a contest for who can create the song I think is the coolest on the music creator. I'm giving out 3 keys to GvF to give to your friends as a reward for first place!  Two keys for second, and one key for third.
  
The rules are, create a screen cap video of you creating an awesome Jam in Melody Island, upload it to youtube, and post it in the official contest thread in the steam community, and this coming Saturday the 25th of July I'll pick my favorite three gnome Jams!

Have fun playing!

Known bugs with newest release:
Bats can't be damaged by berries. I'll get this fixed asap!

DPadY - for zooming camera in (your D-pad up and down)

*Added cheese to the store in Queens' Garden. Go have fun riding the mice around!

*Camera now supports up down motion as well as side to side, and now you zoom in/out with the Dpad or the mouse scroll wheel like always.

*Some Achievements fixed, FairiesCaptured and MonstersKilled should work now

*Directional Lightmaps and Specular lightmaps added to many levels. This makes the file size bigger but the game looks way better with Baked normal maps (texture shadows)

*Fairies Captured are now unique and tracked and saved. So when you catch a fairy once, it stays caught forever and never comes back.  Please report any issues with this system to me!

*Finished all gnome dialog for all gnomes!

*Stores no longer auto sell you the first item on the list!

*Fixed the bats stupid hitbox and how annoying they are. Better now!

Also, I'm having a contest for who can create the song I think is the coolest on the music creator. I'm giving out 3 keys to GvF to give to your friends as a reward for first place!  Two keys for second, and one key for third.
  
The rules are, create a screen cap video of you creating an awesome Jam in Melody Island, upload it to youtube, and post it in the official contest thread in the steam community, and this coming Saturday the 25th of July I'll pick my favorite three gnome Jams!

Have fun playing!

Known bugs with newest release:
Bats can't be damaged by berries. I'll get this fixed asap!

notes.title: Gnomes vs. Fairies v 3.0b is now released! MAJOR update!
notes.content:
The game now exists in the first draft of it's final form.  When you start a new game, there is now a rudimentary cutscene to enjoy that sets the stage.
The main hub world, Queen's Garden is constructed, and connects to the four elemental worlds, each of which connect to 5 stages to explore!
Collect a single crystal from each stage to rebuild the four elemental crystals, which will open up the doorway to reach the final stages and determine the fates!

I've also greatly improved the magic lamp aux item. The magic lamp now changes the nature of your projectiles you throw. Now if you are Ice powered, and have the magic lamp equipped, the projectiles will turn into climbable ice blocks you can jump on to. You can climb up a flat wall face if you have enough berries!  
Fire explodes, wind creates clouds you can jump on to get really high up, and lightning teleports you to the place your berry hit with a cool lightning warp effect!

Please ERASE YOUR OLD GAMES AND START OVER to avoid lots of annoying errors!

As always, please post bugs in the community forum!
Thanks,
Dano
